content: The test image shows a corn stalk with wet, dark, slimy rot at the base/crown area. The tissue is mushy and water-soaked with dark brown discoloration — classic wet bacterial rot. Leaves are yellowing. This strongly suggests Bacterial Stalk Rot.

The appearance matches well despite the reference being a drier stage.
